name: Consumption statement line
description: Line assigning an amount from a consumption statement to a property lot and an ownership.

condo_id.label: Condominium
condo_id.help: The property lot and ownership must belong to this condominium.

consumption_statement_id.label: Consumption statement
consumption_statement_id.description: Consumption statement the line belongs to.
consumption_statement_id.help: Select the consumption statement containing this line.

parent_consumption_meter_id.label: Parent meter
parent_consumption_meter_id.description: Main consumption meter associated with the statement.
parent_consumption_meter_id.help: This meter is inherited automatically from the consumption statement.

consumption_meter_id.label: Consumption meter
consumption_meter_id.description: Individual consumption meter associated with the line.
consumption_meter_id.help: Select the meter linked to the property lot.

ownership_id.label: Ownership file
ownership_id.description: Ownership file to which the amount is assigned.
ownership_id.help: Select the ownership file concerned by this consumption amount.

property_lot_id.label: Property lot
property_lot_id.description: Property lot to which the amount is assigned.
property_lot_id.help: Select the property lot concerned by this consumption amount.

date_from.label: Start date
date_from.description: First date on which the ownership is concerned by the statement line.
date_from.help: This date may differ from the statement start date when an ownership transfer occurred.

date_to.label: End date
date_to.description: Last date on which the ownership is concerned by the statement line.
date_to.help: This date may differ from the statement end date when an ownership transfer occurred.

page_from.label: First page
page_from.description: First page of the property lot section in the source document.
page_from.help: Enter the first page to extract for this line.

page_to.label: Last page
page_to.description: Last page of the property lot section in the source document.
page_to.help: Enter the last page to extract for this line.

document_id.label: Document
document_id.description: Statement document specific to the ownership.
document_id.help: Document generated from the selected page range.

amount.label: Amount
amount.description: Amount assigned to the property lot and ownership.
amount.help: Enter the consumption amount for this line.

list.default.name: Consumption statement lines
list.default.description: Consumption amounts by property lot and ownership.

errors.statement_lines_locked: Statement lines can only be edited while the statement is in the to-encode status.
